choice.basis: The legend maps pale yellow to the high-incidence end (near 100) and dark burgundy to the low end (near 0). WV is pale yellow (high). UT is dark burgundy (low). AL is light yellow (high). Comparing the two high-end candidates, WV's fill is a paler/creamier yellow than AL's slightly deeper yellow, placing WV at a higher position on the monotonic scale. Therefore WV is the highest-incidence state among the options.
